teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville stays No. 1 at 7-2 after a 40-23 win at Tennessee, their third straight. The Jaguars have a 99 percent shot at the playoffs and are favored by 9.1 at the Giants next.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams jump two spots to No. 2 behind a 34-6 win at Arizona, their fourth in a row. The model rates them 2.3 points higher than the betting market does.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: San Francisco slips to No. 3 despite gaining 0.6 rating points, because others gained more. The 49ers beat Dallas 46-40 and are 8-1, with the offense at +3.9 points.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo is 8-1 and 100 percent to make the playoffs after a 31-12 win over the Jets, their fifth straight. Miami visits next, and the Bills are favored by 14.8.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit has won 5 straight, and the latest was a 35-10 win over the Patriots. That moves the Lions up three spots to 5th, powered by an offense worth +2.6 points. The model likes them 2.4 points more than Vegas does.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati beat Pittsburgh 38-18 for a fifth straight win and nudges up to No. 6. The offense is strong at +2.7 points, while the defense sits at -0.6.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: The Bears dropped two spots while sitting out a bye, with their rating down 0.1 points. They're 7-2 with a four-game win streak and host the Saints as 10.4-point favorites.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City moves up one to No. 8 after a 35-13 win at Atlanta. At 7-2, the Chiefs host Arizona next and are favored by 13.0.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle falls three spots to No. 9 even after beating Las Vegas 21-13, because the quarterback situation cost 1.4 points. Drew Lock is the expected starter, and the defense at +1.8 points carries them.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota made the biggest jump of the week, up five spots to No. 10 after a 30-10 win over Green Bay. Their rating rose 3.3 points, with injuries adding 2.2 of that.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver used its bye to hold at No. 11, 7-2 with five straight wins. The point differential is only 12, which is why the rating is a modest +2.2.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay sits 3-6 but still rates +2.0 points, thanks to a defense at +1.6 points. After a bye the Bucs slip to 12th, and they visit Detroit in week 11 as underdogs by 5.2.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay lost 30-10 at home to Minnesota and slips to No. 13. At 6-4 the Packers have a 35 percent playoff chance and travel to face the Rams next.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston lost 27-24 at Cleveland and still rose two spots to No. 14, as injuries added 2.4 points. The model rates them 3.3 points lower than the market does.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England fell two spots to No. 15 after a 35-10 loss at Detroit. The offense dropped 0.5 points and scoring margin another 0.7, leaving the Patriots 5-5.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas lost 46-40 to San Francisco but still gained 1.3 rating points and one spot. The offense is +1.8 points, but the defense at -2.1 explains the 4-6 record.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh drops three spots to No. 17 after a 38-18 loss at Cincinnati, losing 1.0 rating points. The Steelers are still 6-3, but the offense sits at -0.6.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington held at No. 18 with a 24-21 win over the Giants. The Commanders are 3-5-1, and the defense at -0.9 points is the weak spot.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina edged New Orleans 20-17 and holds at No. 19 at 4-5. They have a 38 percent shot at the division and host Baltimore next.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis beat Miami 24-22 and rose two spots to No. 20, helped by 1.9 points from injuries. They're still 3-7 with a 3 percent playoff chance.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta lost 35-13 to Kansas City, its third straight defeat, and falls to No. 21. The offense at -2.1 points is the problem, and the model has them 2.9 points below the market.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants lost 24-21 to Washington and slip one spot to No. 22. They're 5-3-1 and still 53 percent to win the division, despite a rating of -3.5.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland beat Houston 27-24 and rose two spots to No. 23 at 6-4. The offense at -2.4 points is the weakest piece of a team with a -32 point differential.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans lost 20-17 to Carolina yet climbed four spots to No. 24, with injuries adding 1.9 points. The Saints are 3-6 and face the Bears next.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets are 2-8 and have lost five straight, the latest a 31-12 home loss to Buffalo. They fall two spots to No. 25 with a 0 percent playoff chance.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 1-8 but just beat Baltimore 23-20 on the road. They stay at No. 26 and host the Jets as 1.9-point favorites.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia used its bye to climb two spots to No. 27 while riding a seven-game losing streak. Joe Milton III starts, which puts them 3.5 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore drops four spots to No. 28, with the quarterback situation costing 2.3 points. Joe Fagnano starting leaves them 5.2 points below usual, and the model sits 6.7 points under the market.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona lost 34-6 to the Rams and falls two spots to No. 29. The point differential is -105, and Josh Johnson starting puts them 2.0 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee rises two spots to No. 30 despite a 40-23 loss to Jacksonville. Injuries added 2.6 points, though the Titans are 1-8 and the offense sits at -2.2.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami is 1-8 after a 24-22 loss at Indianapolis, its third straight. They hold at No. 31 and are 14.8-point underdogs at Buffalo.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas lands at No. 32 after a 21-13 home loss to Seattle. With a rating of -7.7 and the offense at -1.3, the Raiders visit Denver as 11.9-point underdogs.
